sloka: नास्मिन्नर्थे महाराज त्वं मां प्रियहिते रतम् ।कश्चिल्लघुरिवानार्यो दोषतो गन्तुमर्हसि ।। ६.१०६.१३ ।।
transliteration: nāsminnarthe mahārāja tvaṁ māṁ priyahite ratam ।kaścillaghurivānāryo doṣato gantumarhasi ।। 6.106.13 ।।

translations.english: "O King! I who wish your welfare ought not to be blamed like an unworthy and pettyminded person by mistake."
